list.name: Routing & Page Shell
list.description: Next.js App Router entry points for the public site — the root layout and globals.css shell plus every tenant-scoped [mountain] page (home map, cats, albums, adoption, butler talk, announcements, login, mypage, legal pages) that composes server data into rendered routes.

list.name: Admin CMS
list.description: The AdminAuth-gated content management subsystem: /admin route pages for cats, points, posts, members, media tagging and app management, together with their dedicated admin React components and mutation hooks.

list.name: API Routes
list.description: Serverless route handlers under src/app/api that expose contact, admin mutation, revalidation, YouTube OAuth and permission endpoints, gated server-side by requireApiPermission and backed by the Firebase Admin SDK.

list.name: UI Components
list.description: Reusable client and server React components rendering the cat map, galleries, albums, navigation, modals, auth and post forms, plus the shared ui/ primitive set (Modal, Button, inputs) used across the Korean-language interface.

list.name: Service Layer
list.description: The service-factory abstraction rooted at src/services/index.ts whose lazy per-tenant getters are the codebase central indirection seam, with the interface contracts and Firebase-backed implementations for cats, points, posts, media, permissions, adoption and storage.

list.name: Platform & Tenancy
list.description: Server-side platform seam that resolves the active mountain per request by Host (middleware.ts plus lib/tenant.ts), initializes Firebase Admin, performs server-component data reads, defines ISR cache policy, and enforces authorization through permission-config and requireApiPermission.

list.name: Client State & Hooks
list.description: React hooks and context providers holding client-side state — auth session and idle timeout, effective permission and resource-access resolution, media filtering and linking, responsive viewport detection, and the announcement modal provider.

list.name: Utilities & Constants
list.description: Dependency-free helpers imported by every upper layer: mountain config accessors, cat filtering, map clustering and label layout, date and duration parsing, text linking, the cn class merger, and the Korean UI string constants.

list.name: Shared Types
list.description: TypeScript declaration modules defining the cross-cutting domain shapes — cats, points, media, admin tagging structures and the multi-tenant permission/role model — with no runtime code.

list.name: Declarative Configuration
list.description: Repository-level JSON/YAML configuration read by the tenancy and permission systems: mountains.json per-mountain branding, theme, features and domains, permissions.json RBAC matrix, and the parked Cloud Run deployment manifest.
